id: \bAlain: Of all people I get to battle in the finals, it's you. Show me more of the power you hold.
en: \bAlain: Of all people I get to battle in the finals, it's you.  Show me more of the power you hold.
it: \bAlain: Fra tutti quelli che potevo affrontare in finale, mi tocca proprio tu.  Mostrami di più del potere che possiedi.

id: \bAlain: Did you hear that? Something is going on outside.
en: \bAlain: Did you hear that? Something is going on outside.
it: \bAlain: Hai sentito? Sta succedendo qualcosa fuori.

id: \bLysandre: People of Kalos. Listen well. My name is Lysandre, the leader of Team Flare. As of now this region belongs to me.
en: \bLysandre: People of Kalos. Listen well. My name is Lysandre, the leader of Team Flare. As of now this region belongs to me.
it: \bElisio: Popolo di Kalos. Ascoltate bene. Il mio nome è Elisio, capo del Team Flare. Da questo momento questa regione appartiene a me.

id: \bTry and fight and you will be crushed. Just relax and wait for the world to be destroyed. That is all.
en: \bTry and fight and you will be crushed. Just relax and wait for the world to be destroyed. That is all.
it: \bProvate a combattere e sarete schiacciati. Rilassatevi e aspettate che il mondo venga distrutto. È tutto.

id: \rDrasna: How nice to meet you, young Trainer. I bet you expect to walk away with a win. Well, good luck.
en: \rDrasna: How nice to meet you, young Trainer. I bet you expect to walk away with a win. Well, good luck.
it: \rDrasna: Che piacere conoscerti, giovane Allenatore. Scommetto che ti aspetti di andartene con una vittoria. Beh, buona fortuna.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 9.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 9.
it: Smart Rotom: In base alle prestazioni, il tuo grado ora è 9.
